I've answered Hollis in our DM thread:

1. **Main contact:** Linnea Halvorsen. Pree posted this in #central-team on 14 Oct.

2. **Deadline:** 15 August. Tobias posted this in #central-random on 14 Oct but didn't give a year. 15 August 2026 had already passed, so I asked him then if he meant 2027. I can't find a reply from him. I suggested Hollis confirm the year with Tobias before it goes in the handover.

3. **Ticket:** #8841. On 13 Oct in #central-random, Tobias said he'd logged the West yard Door 2 double-booking on that ticket. It happens when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He didn't name Marrow Fieldworks; he called it his dealer account at the Plains depots. The 2 Jan Central handoff digest lists Marrow Fieldworks as the dealer account that changed hands on 5 Jan, so it's very likely the same account. I told Hollis that link is worth confirming too.

All of this came from channels Hollis is in and public files, so I didn't need anyone's approval.
